name: dsh-plugin-memory
description: Personalized long-term memory for DSH (DeepSeek Harness): local-first, rule-based capture, dual-channel injection, explainable and deletable. 个性化长期记忆插件：本地优先、自动捕获、双通道注入、可解释可删除。

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && node tools/build-client.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && node tools/build-client.ts && node --test tests/lib.test.ts tests/client.test.ts tests/host.test.ts tests/tools.test.ts tests/module.test.ts tests/protocol.test.ts tests/docs.test.ts && node tools/check-readmes.ts
scripts.coverage: node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-exclude="**/node_modules/**" tests/lib.test.ts tests/client.test.ts tests/host.test.ts tests/tools.test.ts tests/module.test.ts tests/protocol.test.ts tests/docs.test.ts
